packageRules.description: One pull request for every stable minor and patch update, which the shared preset automerges
One pull request for pre-1.0 minor and patch updates, kept apart from the automerged group
Group Vitest and its packages, whose versions must match exactly
Group the oxc tools, which change what lint and format report together
kopje is this repository's own package: bump the deploy/ template as soon as a version is on npm
The override in pnpm-workspace.yaml replaces the sdk-metrics 2.7.1 that @fedify/fedify pins; keep it on the 2.x line Fedify is built against
The kopje-main-runtime project's test pool (pnpm-workspace.yaml) stays on the plugin release whose workerd has SQLite 3.53.4, the runtime that prepares main's statements
lefthook 2.2.2 was published without the provenance its earlier releases carry, and pnpm refuses it as a trust downgrade; skip it until a release with provenance
